who: Stoica S. Eduard & Asociații is a Bucharest-based notary public that provides online preparation of notarial acts and a forum/Q&A for Romanians abroad on topics such as power of attorney (procură) for real estate transactions.
fit_reason: The page targets diaspora needing legal assistance for property purchases or succession, not individuals actively building, renovating, or monitoring a construction project in Romania. While it serves the diaspora, there is no signal of ongoing house‑building activity that Ochi pe Șantier addresses.
hooks: Position Ochi pe Șantier as a complementary service that gives diaspora clients visual proof of construction progress after they have granted a procură for the purchase.
Emphasize how weekly drone reports reduce reliance on relatives’ WhatsApp photos or blind trust, helping prevent disputes and cost overruns after the property is secured via notarized procură.
